data.title: BlackRock files for bitcoin ETF offering downside protection and upside exposure to IBIT
data.summary_raw: One of the world's largest investment managers, BlackRock has filed for another bitcoin fund, marking its third tied to the asset.

data.title: Mesh taps Visa to let users spend crypto without a separate card
data.summary_raw: Mesh and Visa will let users spend crypto and stablecoin balances from wallet apps, with no need to sell or transfer assets first.

data.title: Mastercard unveils Stablecoin Security tool to screen payments for fraud and sanctions risks
data.summary_raw: Mastercard unveiled Stablecoin Security, a risk screening service launching in North America before planned global availability in 2027.

data.title: Galaxy’s AI data center business is undervalued amid CoreWeave debt concerns, StoneX says
data.summary_raw: StoneX reiterates Buy and $57 target on GLXY, saying the market undervalues its Helios AI data center despite CoreWeave debt worries.
